ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: the main body in the figure is a five-membered ring structure, ignoring the curved arrows. On the ring, N can be seen connected to O, and O is then connected to the central carbon on the right; there is a double bond between N and the left carbon, and the left double-bonded carbon is connected to R1; this double-bonded carbon is then connected to the lower/middle carbon, which is connected to R2 and continues to connect back to the central carbon on the right. The central carbon on the right is also connected to two oxygen substituents: one is O-H, and the other is OR. Then reason: use the wildcard * to represent an R group. According to the specified traversal, start from the R end of OR, write it as *O, then enter the central ring carbon and mark ring opening as C1; the central carbon has a hydroxyl branch, written as C1(O). Then proceed along the ring through O-N, and use N=C to represent the imine double bond in the figure; this imine carbon carries an R1 branch, written as =C(*). Then go to the adjacent carbon carrying R2 and close the ring, written as C1*. Combining gives the SMILES: *OC1(O)ON=C(*)C1*.

raw_record.question_text: What is the SMILES expression of the transition-state structure shown in the image, ignoring the arrows?

method.method_draft: First describe the image as a molecular graph, excluding arrows: an OR substituent is attached through O to a central ring carbon; that same central carbon has an OH branch and is part of a five-membered O-N=C-C-C ring with wildcard R groups on the imine carbon and adjacent carbon. Then choose a SMILES traversal beginning at the wildcard of OR: `*O`, enter the central ring atom as `C1(O)`, continue through ring oxygen and nitrogen `ON`, encode the imine bond to the substituted carbon `=C(*)`, go to the next carbon bearing R2 `C1*`, and close the ring. This gives `*OC1(O)ON=C(*)C1*`.
method.CoT_raw: 先描述图像：图中主体是一个五元环结构，忽略弯曲箭头。环上可见 N 与 O 相连，O 再连到右侧的中心碳；N 与左侧碳之间是双键，左侧双键碳连有 R1；该双键碳再连到下方/中间的碳，该碳连有 R2，并继续连回右侧中心碳。右侧中心碳还连有两个氧取代基：一个是 O-H，另一个是 OR。再推理：用通配符 * 表示 R 基。按指定遍历从 OR 的 R 端开始，写作 *O，然后进入中心环碳并标记开环为 C1；中心碳有一个羟基支链，写作 C1(O)。随后沿环经过 O-N，并用 N=C 表示图中的亚胺双键；该亚胺碳带 R1 支链，写作 =C(*)。再到带 R2 的相邻碳并闭环，写作 C1*。合并得到 SMILES：*OC1(O)ON=C(*)C1*。

planner_metadata.distinctiveness_rationale: This is the direct structure-to-SMILES transcription route: identify the molecular graph in the drawing and encode it, treating R groups as wildcard attachment atoms and ignoring all curved arrows. No alternative route is needed for this single visual conversion task.
planner_metadata.image_role: Read the skeletal drawing as a five-membered ring: central acetal-like carbon bonded to ring O, ring carbon bearing R2, an OH substituent, and an OR substituent; ring O bonded to N; N double-bonded to the left ring carbon; that left ring carbon bears R1 and is single-bonded to the bottom ring carbon; the bottom ring carbon bears R2 and closes back to the central carbon. Ignore the curved arrows and proton-transfer markings.
planner_metadata.text_role: Use the question instruction that the requested output is the SMILES expression of the transition-state structure and that arrows in the image should be ignored.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Use SMILES conventions: represent unspecified R groups as wildcard atoms '*'; encode the five-member ring with ring index 1; use parentheses for substituents such as OH and wildcard branches; preserve the N=C double bond and single O-N/C-O bonds. A valid traversal is wildcard-oxygen substituent into the central ring carbon, around O-N=C-C back to the central carbon.
